source.headline: Oil prices rise to 6-week high after Iran and U.S. trade blows, Saudi Aramco facilities reportedly hit

US2Y.source: latest U.S. close before Labor Day holiday

US10Y.source: latest U.S. close before Labor Day holiday

VIX.source: latest CBOE close before U.S. holiday

learning_v2.note: ACTIONABLE v2 aggregate directional segments were KEEP_NEUTRAL and no ACTIONABLE context-aware segment justified a material confidence change; current facts and contemporaneous oil/USD context dominate.

predictions.mechanism: A fresh reported strike on Saudi Aramco infrastructure broadens the conflict from shipping risk toward physical energy infrastructure, increasing geopolitical safe-haven demand while oil remains near six-week highs.
predictions.invalidation: Damage proves immaterial, Saudi output/export capacity is unaffected, and oil rapidly gives back the escalation premium.

predictions.mechanism: Higher crude and direct attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure raise imported-energy and geopolitical risk premia for Germany's industrial-heavy market.
predictions.invalidation: Oil retreats sharply and the Aramco incident is confirmed to have no meaningful supply consequence.

predictions.mechanism: A broader Middle East energy-infrastructure threat worsens the inflation and input-cost backdrop for euro-area equities.
predictions.invalidation: A credible de-escalation or rapid normalization of oil prices removes the new risk premium.

predictions.mechanism: French equities face the same regional risk-off and imported-energy shock, but with less direct industrial sensitivity than Germany.
predictions.invalidation: European risk appetite recovers while crude falls back below the pre-escalation range.

predictions.mechanism: Japan's dependence on imported energy makes sustained Gulf supply risk a negative terms-of-trade shock, while risk aversion can also strengthen the yen and pressure exporters.
predictions.invalidation: Oil prices retreat materially and the yen weakens enough to offset the energy-cost shock.

predictions.mechanism: Silver can benefit from softer USD and safe-haven demand, but industrial-growth concerns from higher energy prices cap conviction versus gold.
predictions.invalidation: The dollar rebounds materially or geopolitical risk premium fades quickly.
